instruction: Hide rows 32 and 33 in the spreadsheet. Do not delete any cells.

metadata.capability_extraction: Can right-click row headers, use 'Hide Rows' from context menu, navigate spreadsheet, select rows. Can select multiple adjacent rows.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model incorrectly identified which rows had #N/A values. Got confused by row numbering changes as rows were hidden. Hid some non-N/A rows and missed some N/A rows.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests hiding 2 adjacent rows (32 and 33), which are both N/A rows near the bottom of the spreadsheet. Slightly harder than variation 0 but much simpler than the original 13-row task.
metadata.explanation: Task asks to hide rows 32 and 33. Getter checks row hidden properties via openpyxl. Metric verifies both rows are hidden with partial credit (0.5 per row).
